# Requested recording exclusions

Names, tracker versions, types and available audio identifiers were captured from the public [Yeat tracker](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FUzAZyTCgFTVxQ--qbCAS2bUk4dsAw6ASxwjURPHbyI/edit) on 2026-10-22. `excluded/` contains the 60 rows in the maintainer's exclusion request, including producer-only tracks. `retained/` contains 27 neighboring versions with Yeat that the request does not exclude. Fleek V2 remains excluded by the earlier, separate maintainer decision and is not a retained fixture.

These fixtures deliberately make every row playable, including currently unavailable demos and snippets, to verify that later availability cannot bypass the policy. Rows without playable sources receive deterministic synthetic Pillows ids. The common Test era forces same-title rows to merge, testing per-recording eligibility independently of their original era separation. No synthetic audio is downloaded or claimed to establish a vocal relationship.
